statuses.EXISTS: file is in src/assets/art or an approved (KEEP) candidate file on a sibling branch
statuses.NEEDS-SLICE: raw sheet exists, cut with tools/slice-sheet.mjs (none found)
statuses.NEEDS-ART: must be generated or fixed in ChatGPT; brief included
statuses.CODE-DRAWN: shapes, gradients or text drawn by the game, no art

styleRules: STYLE LOCK: warm dark-brown outline (not black) 3-4% of sprite height, light from top-left, thin rim light bottom-right, soft contact shadow, 3-4 value steps, glossy toy-metal look like the accepted medallion/popup kit. KEY: one sprite per grid cell on flat #FF00FF magenta; if the art contains pink, magenta, red-purple or a pink glow use flat #00FF00 green instead; never a gradient or shadow on the key; no baked text or numbers; 6-10% padding inside the cell; nothing within 3 px of the cell edge. RANK CLARITY: states/tiers in one family must differ in at least two of silhouette, size, part count, accent colour, pips, and still read apart at 70 px in grayscale.
